kjv: the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee
mine: the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you
note: splanchna (inward parts) was the seat of feeling; "bowels" now reads as anatomy. Also 1:12, 1:20.

kjv: thou therefore receive him (Onesimus), that is, mine own bowels
note: TR adds "proslabou" (receive him), supplying the missing verb; absent from Sinaiticus*, A, C.
